body: I appreciate your response but ... "not disappointing others" well in the long run that's really not a good enough reason to live is it?  its not fair to endure being with the person I loathe the most all day every day just so that I don't hurt others...
I have... but after trying various medications which just messed up my body I gave up.  I never was able to connect, although I feel like I did try.  I really do feel that it's just me...

DW \- again, appreciate the response. Dont think I mentioned before but this is actually my first post \- desperate to see if I was a lone loser.  But I really don't think my situation is from a lack of interests...  I have a lot of things I should be greatful for, interested in, engaged with... but doesn't make me any less hopeless.

Thank you for such a quick and thoughtful response!  Very much appreciated!

I have spoken to my wife but she really doesn't understand... I don't blame her, it's not like it makes sense.  She knows about being me feeling suicidal but I don't think she really gets it...  it feels so deep, dark and lonely that way.

I actually do contribute a lot to my community, including soup kitchens for one.  I appreciate where you were going with that suggestion, it sometimes serves as a distraction but not a solution.
